# DeepValues.AI

> AI-native financial assistant for individual investors — institutional-grade stock research that aligns only with your interest. Built by LuLu Ventures LLC.

In one sentence: DeepValues is a value-investing research app that shows what a company is worth by three valuation models, what well-known investors and members of Congress bought and sold, and AI research briefings that show their sources.

- Who it is for: individual investors who do their own fundamental research on US-listed companies.
- What it costs: the Basic plan is $0 with no card; Plus is $9.99 a month or $79.99 a year, with a 7-day trial for first-time subscribers.
- Where to get it: on the web at https://app.deepvalues.ai, on iPhone (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/deepvalues/id6775568608) and on Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.deepvalues.android).

DeepValues.AI brings the kind of deep, multi-analyst stock research traditionally locked behind expensive Wall Street terminals to individual retail investors. The product runs an AI research pipeline that reads every SEC filing, earnings transcript, and 13F holding for a company, then produces a structured briefing covering business moat, intrinsic value, financials, smart-money positioning, and recent filings.

The brand premise: Wall Street works for Wall Street, not for you. DeepValues.AI is explicitly aligned with the individual investor — no advertiser kickbacks, no promoted stocks, no affiliate links inside research, no conflicts of interest. The credits you spend are the actual cost of running the multi-analyst AI pipeline on your behalf, because that's the only way the product makes money.

## Core Features

- **AI Research Briefings**: On-demand multi-analyst reports for any US-listed stock. The pipeline reads filings, transcripts, and market data, then writes a fully-sourced briefing.
- **Buffett Lens**: Voice and text chat with an AI grounded in a company's public disclosures. Every answer cites its sources.
- **Smart Money tracking**: 93 tracked investors — 80 funds' 13F filings (Warren Buffett, Bill Ackman, Joel Greenblatt, Duan Yongping, Ken Griffin, Ray Dalio and more), plus 12 members of Congress (STOCK Act disclosures) and one official (OGE disclosures). Their holdings, quarter-over-quarter changes, and where the money moved each quarter.
- **Values Watchlist**: Personal watchlist with color-coded value metrics (P/E, ROE, ROIC, intrinsic value) judged against the thresholds Buffett, Munger, Greenblatt, and other legends actually used.
- **Filings & Earnings**: A company's 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and proxy filings, each with a plain-English AI summary, plus a recap of the latest earnings call.
- **Financials Deep Dive**: Full company financial history sourced directly from SEC filings — every income line, cash-flow line, balance-sheet line, with cross-period comparison.
- **How It Makes Money**: AI-generated Sankey-diagram revenue breakdown — segment revenue, cost of revenue, operating expenses, taxes, all the way to net income, in one view.
- **Intrinsic Value Calculator**: Three independent valuation models — free cash flow (DCF), Buffett's owner earnings, and Damodaran's two-stage model — with every input shown.
- **Macro gauges**: The Buffett Indicator and Shiller PE on every plan; Plus adds VIX, AAII sentiment, the 10-year Treasury and the Fed balance sheet, with full history.

## Pricing

The source of truth is the pricing page: https://app.deepvalues.ai/en/pricing

- **Basic ($0, no card)** — 9 credits at signup, enough for 3 fresh briefings, then 0.75 credits a week (about one fresh briefing a month). Unlimited watchlist, every guru with a weekly email digest, the Buffett Indicator and Shiller PE, Buffett Lens, filings and AI filing summaries.
- **Plus — $9.99/month or $79.99/year** — 7-day trial for first-time subscribers. About 6 fresh briefings a month (4 credits every week), a realtime email alert when a guru you follow moves, and every macro indicator with full history.
- **Credits** — a fresh briefing costs 3 credits; opening one someone already ran costs 0.25. Credit packs top up either plan.
- **API and MCP server** — live, paid per call from the same credits, no subscription. Docs, per-call prices and keys: https://app.deepvalues.ai/developers. MCP server: https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/mcp

## Languages

The web app and the iPhone app are available in 26 languages. The marketing site is available in 27: English, Arabic, Bengali, German, Latin American Spanish, European Spanish, French, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Marathi, Malay, Dutch, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Urdu, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. The language is detected from the browser and can be switched by hand. Every language has its own landing page: Arabic https://deepvalues.ai/ar/ · Bengali https://deepvalues.ai/bn/ · German https://deepvalues.ai/de/ · Latin American Spanish https://deepvalues.ai/es-419/ · European Spanish https://deepvalues.ai/es-es/ · French https://deepvalues.ai/fr/ · Hindi https://deepvalues.ai/hi/ · Indonesian https://deepvalues.ai/id/ · Italian https://deepvalues.ai/it/ · Japanese https://deepvalues.ai/ja/ · Korean https://deepvalues.ai/ko/ · Marathi https://deepvalues.ai/mr/ · Malay https://deepvalues.ai/ms/ · Dutch https://deepvalues.ai/nl/ · Polish https://deepvalues.ai/pl/ · Brazilian Portuguese https://deepvalues.ai/pt-br/ · Russian https://deepvalues.ai/ru/ · Swedish https://deepvalues.ai/sv/ · Tamil https://deepvalues.ai/ta/ · Telugu https://deepvalues.ai/te/ · Thai https://deepvalues.ai/th/ · Turkish https://deepvalues.ai/tr/ · Urdu https://deepvalues.ai/ur/ · Vietnamese https://deepvalues.ai/vi/ · Simplified Chinese https://deepvalues.ai/zh-hans/ · Traditional Chinese https://deepvalues.ai/zh-hant/. The privacy policy, the terms and the Buffett Indicator privacy policy are translated as well; the English version governs.

## Topics covered

Value investing; intrinsic value (discounted cash flow, owner earnings, two-stage models); margin of safety; stock valuation of US-listed companies; Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger's principles; 13F holdings of tracked investors; the Buffett Indicator (market cap / GDP) and Shiller PE (CAPE); SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) explained in plain English. Chinese-language coverage: 價值投資、巴菲特、內在價值、安全邊際、美股分析。

## Important disclaimers

DeepValues.AI is an AI research and education product, not a registered investment adviser. AI briefings are factual research, not personalized investment advice. Users are responsible for their own investment decisions. AI can be wrong or out of date — every output cites its source so users can verify. DeepValues and the Buffett Indicator app are not affiliated with Warren Buffett or Berkshire Hathaway.

The product does not store Buffett Lens voice audio on its servers; audio is streamed to Microsoft Azure Speech Services for real-time transcription only, and neither party retains it after transcription completes. Users' inputs and outputs are never used to train any foundation model (OpenAI and Anthropic are used under their API/enterprise no-training terms).
